# Counter Starter

Source starter for testing marketplace submission. This is not an approved catalog release.

Uses actual Rice SDK defineApp/createWindow/Column/Label/Button/Message.ACTIVATE. Increment and reset a counter. No network/filesystem/bus/service permissions. Image is an SDK control reference preview, not a native RiceWM capture.

Source is in src/, exported artifact in dist/. marketplace.json is the listing, build.json maps every artifact member to source, media.json gives credits and reference limitations. All source/icons/reference previews are MIT licensed.

Use exact commit with source root packages/cwittenberg/counter-starter/1.0.0 and repository-relative paths packages/cwittenberg/counter-starter/1.0.0/marketplace.json, packages/cwittenberg/counter-starter/1.0.0/build.json and packages/cwittenberg/counter-starter/1.0.0/media.json.

Fork to your repository, change publisher/repository/app IDs, capture actual RiceWM screenshots, export fresh bytes and submit a new exact commit. Missing automated security checks, native UX proof and operator approval still block publication.
